items.title: Loop Industries Appoints Spencer Hart as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Loop Industries, Inc. (Nasdaq:LOOP) ("Loop" or the "Company"), a clean technology company on a mission to accelerate a circular plastics economy by manufacturing 100% recycled polyethylene terephthalate ("PET") plastic and polyester fiber, today announced the appointment of Spencer Hart as Chief Financial Officer (CFO), effective January 15, 2026.

items.title: Loop Industries and Ester Industries’ India Joint Venture Awards Detailed Engineering Contract to Toyo for Infinite Loop™ India
items.summary: Loop Industries today announced that its India joint-venture ELITe, formed in partnership with Ester Industries, has awarded the detailed engineering contract for its Infinite Loop™ India project to Toyo Engineering India Private Limited, a globally recognized EPC firm with over four decades of experience executing large-scale industrial and petrochemical projects across India.

items.title: Loop Industries and Hyosung TNC Launch Strategic Alliance to Support Shift by Global Brands to Circular Polyester
items.summary: This alliance combines Loop’s Infinite Loop™ depolymerization technology and Hyosung TNC’s industry-leading expertise in advanced textile materials to help brands transition from fossil and bottle-based polyester, to next-generation circular materials.

items.title: Loop Industries and Shinkong Launch Strategic Alliance to Support Shift By Global Brands to Circular Polyester
items.summary: Partnership formed to combine Loop's technology and Shinkong's spinning capabilities and distribution network. Alliance with Shinkong will further enhance global growth opportunities for Twist™, Loop's textile-to-textile branded polyester resin for textile and apparel brands. Loop can now offer high-quality circular polyester yarns made from Twist™, helping customers access next-gen materials more easily. Shinkong can now offer Twist™ textile-to-textile branded resin to its portfolio of over 100 customers worldwide.

items.title: Loop Industries’ India Joint Venture Reaches Agreement to Acquire Strategic Site in Gujarat, India, for Infinite Loop Manufacturing Facility
items.summary: Agreement reached to acquire site in the Gujarat state in India with strategic access to textile waste for feedstock, renewable clean energy, industrial infrastructure. Sufficient land on site for both initial 70,000 metric ton facility and further 100,000 metric ton capacity expansion. Total cost of the land is $10.5M which represents $5M reduction in the amount included in project cost estimate.
